translations.web: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.
translations.bsb: You have condemned and murdered the righteous, who did not resist you.
translations.kjv: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
translations.asv: Ye have condemned, ye have killed the righteous one; he doth not resist you.
